latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor iPad — fast, cloud-based video editing for iPad content creators.

- Upload MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM (up to 500MB) and request edits using natural language instructions.
- Handles trimming, transitions, aspect ratio changes, overlays, and fast 1080p MP4 exports, all optimized for mobile and social platforms.
- Automatic backend connection and free credit token flow; setup is handled for the user.
- Supports common video/audio/image formats and delivers shareable, ready-to-post clips within minutes.
- Clear workflows for quick edits, batch processes, and iterative refinements with persistent timeline state.
